name: AetherBuilder
changelog: Security: Server-side session token validation — all admin endpoints now require a signed token
Security: CORS restricted from wildcard (*) to a domain allowlist
Security: Rate limiting on form submissions (3/min) and login attempts (10/min)
Security: data/config.json, data/ratelimit.json blocked from web access via .htaccess
Added: verify_session, validate_token, and save_admin_hash API endpoints
Fixed: Visual repeater for Nav Links & Dropdowns in Navbar/Header and navigation add-ons
Fixed: Submenu builder now supports page selector dropdowns and URL inputs
Updated: Official AetherBuilder logo applied across admin UI and login modal
